info.name: Vending server API
info.description:
PokeVend vending-server: the admin API (/api/admin, Bearer token) and the machine API (/api/machine, X-Machine-Key).

Run the folders in order with the Collection Runner: each request saves what the next one needs (tokens, ids, the catalog version). Before the first run, set `machineKey` to an active machine's key (`./deploy/deploy.sh USER@IP keys`, or the seed-demo output). Folder 11 deletes all data; run it only on purpose.

Errors are a non-2xx status with {code, message, fields?}. Times in answers are Unix milliseconds (UTC); dates in queries are YYYY-MM-DD in WIB.
